_note: Language-model options. Choose one with NI_LLM_PRESET (off | quality | economy | local). Each preset says why it exists. Prices: US$ per million tokens, Anthropic first-party API, from Anthropic's model table dated 2026-11-03 (checked 2026-11-15); cache_write = 1.25x input (5-minute cache); cache_read for Haiku 5.5 and older models assumed at 0.1x input (not listed). Re-check https://www.anthropic.com/pricing before relying on budgets.

quality.why: Anthropic's most capable default model; use for difficult or client-critical re-analysis. Measured 2026-11-15: event type 0.98 (one sentence better than 'economy') but attribution 0.89, at about $2 per 1,000 sentences.

economy.why: Recommended default when an LLM is on. Measured 2026-11-15 on the labelled set (scope 'all'): event type 0.96 vs 0.69 for word lists, attribution 0.98, at about $0.06 per 1,000 sentences - about 35x cheaper than 'quality' with near-equal accuracy.

local.why: Runs on your own machine: $0 per call and no text leaves the machine. Quality depends on the model pulled - compare with `evaluate` first.

measured.note: 52 sentences: differences of 1-2 sentences are noise. Re-measure when the labelled set grows to 200-500 real sentences.
